short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.1 Valley Incision Baseline is ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on head 42940c0b7f16b2ccf3704d7e603691415b1360cf with G8.0 parent PASS, valley baseline PASS, geomorphology ownership PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, STOPPED lifecycle and CLEAN working tree. G8.2 is now implemented as river-channel incision composed on the accepted G8.1 valley result using the same semantic bundle and profile. Inputs add accepted geo/river-distance-m and geo/river-width-m. Full channel width is interpreted as +/- half-width around the centerline: the core reaches river_max_depth_m, the outer river_edge_softness_ratio band fades cubically to zero, and at/beyond half-width river incision is zero. G8.2 preserves the exact valley component and adds only river_channel_delta_m; bank/floodplain/erosion-deposition remain zero. No SurfaceCellKey, LOD, Matter, authority, persistence, material or network ownership is introduced. Focused and full Windows validation are pending.
